profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions. Per its own site, it makes lidar sensors for ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and industrial applications, and it says it works with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide, with mass-produced lidars delivered to customers in over 40 countries.

The company frames lidar as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), along with advanced semi-autonomous driving. It also says its sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving, aimed at robotaxis, robobuses, and other autonomous fleets operating with little to no human input.

The record holds no litigation and no tracked products or MCP servers for the company. Its registration details list a CIK of 0001861737 and a for-profit public company status.
